vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.
